examples.title: Example 1: Setting Toolbar Items to Different States
examples.description: This example shows the various display effects when the state property of toolbar items is set to ENABLE, DISABLE, or ACTIVATE.

examples.title: Example 2: Customizing the Toolbar Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the toolbar's height, background color, and other styles using ToolBarModifier. This functionality is supported since API version 13.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Screen Reader Announcement
examples.description: This example customizes the screen reader announcement text by setting the accessibilityText, accessibilityDescription, and accessibilityLevel properties of the toolbar item. This functionality is supported since API version 18.
